exhibits.definition: to examine facts carefully to find out the truth
exhibits.example: The audit team will investigate the billing error before issuing the monthly report.

translations.th_TH: เพื่อตรวจสอบ; เพื่อตรวจสอบ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 仔細查明事實以找出真相
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 真実を知るために事実を慎重に調べる
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 진실을 알아내기 위해 사실을 자세히 조사하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: xem xét sự việc cẩn thận để tìm ra sự thật
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ตรวจสอบข้อเท็จจริงอย่างรอบคอบเพื่อหาความจริง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 稽核團隊將在發布月報前調查這項帳單錯誤。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The audit team will investigate the billing error before issuing the monthly report.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 監査チームは、月次報告を発行する前に請求の誤りを調査します。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 감사팀은 월간 보고서를 발행하기 전에 청구 오류를 조사할 것이다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nhóm kiểm toán sẽ điều tra lỗi thanh toán trước khi phát hành báo cáo hàng tháng.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ทีมตรวจสอบจะตรวจสอบข้อผิดพลาดในการเรียกเก็บเงินก่อนออกรายงานประจำเดือน

exhibits.definition: to doubt or feel suspicious about someone or something
exhibits.example: Investigators need to suspect the seemingly innocuous evidence as it may conceal the real perpetrator.

translations.ja_JP: 疑うこと。不信感を抱く
translations.th_TH: ผู้ต้องสงสัย

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 懷疑或對某人或某事感到可疑
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 人や物事を疑う、または不審に思う
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 누군가나 무언가를 의심하거나 수상하게 여기다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: nghi ngờ hoặc cảm thấy không tin về ai đó hay điều gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สงสัยหรือรู้สึกไม่ไว้วางใจคนหรือสิ่งใดสิ่งหนึ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 調查人員需要懷疑這些看似無害的證據，因為它們可能隱藏著真正的罪犯。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Investigators need to suspect the seemingly innocuous evidence as it may conceal the real perpetrator.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 捜査官は、一見無害な証拠を疑う必要があります。なぜなら、それが真犯人を隠している可能性があるからです。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 조사관들은 겉보기에 무해한 증거라도 실제 범인을 숨기고 있을 수 있으므로 의심해야 합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Điều tra viên cần nghi ngờ những bằng chứng tưởng chừng vô hại, vì chúng có thể che giấu thủ phạm thật sự.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ผู้สืบสวนต้องสงสัยหลักฐานที่ดูเหมือนไม่มีพิษภัย เพราะหลักฐานนั้นอาจช่วยปกปิดตัวผู้กระทำผิดที่แท้จริง

exhibits.definition: an official legal document that gives permission for an action such as an arrest or search
exhibits.example: When making an arrest, the police must present a legal warrant to ensure the validity and legality of the arrest.

translations.th_TH: หมายจับ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 授權逮捕或搜查等行動的正式法律文件
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 逮捕や捜索などの行為を許可する正式な法的文書
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 체포나 수색 같은 행위를 허가하는 공식 법적 문서
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: văn bản pháp lý chính thức cho phép hành động như bắt giữ hoặc khám xét
definitionTranslations.th_TH: เอกสารทางกฎหมายอย่างเป็นทางการที่อนุญาตให้กระทำการ เช่น จับกุมหรือค้นหา

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 警方在執行逮捕時需要出示合法的證書，這保證了逮捕的合理性和合法性，這就是為什麼他們必須獲得______的原因。
exampleTranslations.en_US: When making an arrest, the police must present a legal warrant to ensure the validity and legality of the arrest.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 逮捕を行う際、警察は逮捕の有効性と合法性を保証するために、法的な令状を提示しなければなりません。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 체포를 할 때 경찰은 체포의 타당성과 합법성을 보장하기 위해 법적 영장을 제시해야 합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khi tiến hành bắt giữ, cảnh sát phải xuất trình lệnh hợp pháp để bảo đảm tính chính đáng và hợp pháp của việc bắt giữ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เมื่อทำการจับกุม ตำรวจต้องแสดงหมายจับที่ถูกต้องตามกฎหมายเพื่อให้แน่ใจว่าการจับกุมนั้นมีความชอบธรรมและถูกต้องตามกฎหมาย

exhibits.definition: a person who answers questions in a survey or study
exhibits.example: In conducting this research, the respondent's replies are crucial for the accuracy of the results.

translations.th_TH: ผู้ตอบแบบสอบถาม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 受訪者
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: （調査などの）回答者
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: (설문 등의) 응답자
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: người trả lời (khảo sát)
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ผู้ตอบแบบสอบถาม

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在進行這項研究時，受訪者的回應對結果的準確性至關重要。
exampleTranslations.en_US: In conducting this research, the respondent's replies are crucial for the accuracy of the results.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: この調査を行うにあたり、回答者の回答は結果の正確さにとって極めて重要です。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 연구를 진행하는 데 있어 응답자의 답변은 결과의 정확성에 매우 중요하다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khi tiến hành nghiên cứu này, câu trả lời của người được khảo sát vô cùng quan trọng đối với độ chính xác của kết quả.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในการทำวิจัยนี้ คำตอบของผู้ตอบแบบสอบถามมีความสำคัญอย่างยิ่งต่อความแม่นยำของผลลัพธ์

exhibits.definition: the legal right or duty to care for a child
exhibits.example: After a lengthy court hearing, the judge ultimately ruled to grant custody of the child to the mother for the best interest of the child's welfare.

translations.th_TH: สิทธิในการดูแลบุตร

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 照顧兒童的法定權利或義務
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 子供を保護する法的権利または義務
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 아동을 돌볼 법적 권리 또는 의무
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: quyền hoặc nghĩa vụ pháp lý chăm sóc một đứa trẻ
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สิทธิหรือหน้าที่ตามกฎหมายในการดูแลเด็ก

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 經過漫長的法庭審理，法官最終決定將孩子的監護權授予母親，以最佳照顧孩子的福利。
exampleTranslations.en_US: After a lengthy court hearing, the judge ultimately ruled to grant custody of the child to the mother for the best interest of the child's welfare.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 長時間に及ぶ法廷審理の後、裁判官は最終的に、子どもの福祉の最善の利益を考慮して、母親に親権を認める判決を下しました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 오랜 법정 심리 끝에 판사는 결국 아이의 복지를 최우선으로 고려하여 어머니에게 양육권을 주기로 판결했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Sau phiên tòa kéo dài, thẩm phán cuối cùng đã phán quyết giao quyền nuôi con cho người mẹ vì lợi ích tốt nhất cho phúc lợi của đứa trẻ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: หลังจากการไต่สวนในศาลที่ยืดเยื้อ ผู้พิพากษาได้ตัดสินในที่สุดให้มารดาได้รับสิทธิ์ดูแลบุตร เพื่อประโยชน์สูงสุดต่อสวัสดิภาพของเด็ก

exhibits.definition: to represent or support someone in a legal case or argument
exhibits.example: The lawyer's job is to defend their clients, ensuring they receive justice in the legal system.

translations.th_TH: ปกป้อง

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 在法律案件或爭論中代表或支持某人
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 訴訟や議論で誰かを代理または支持する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 법적 사건이나 논쟁에서 누군가를 대변하거나 지지하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: đại diện hoặc ủng hộ ai đó trong vụ kiện hay tranh luận
definitionTranslations.th_TH: เป็นตัวแทนหรือสนับสนุนใครบางคนในคดีหรือการโต้แย้ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 律師的工作是為客戶辯護，確保他們在法律上獲得公正。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The lawyer's job is to defend their clients, ensuring they receive justice in the legal system.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 弁護士の仕事は依頼人を擁護し、法制度の中で正義が受けられるようにすることです。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 변호사의 일은 의뢰인을 변호하여 그들이 법 체계에서 정의를 받도록 하는 것이다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Công việc của luật sư là bảo vệ thân chủ, bảo đảm họ nhận được công lý trong hệ thống pháp luật.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: งานของทนายความคือการปกป้องลูกความของตน เพื่อให้พวกเขาได้รับความยุติธรรมในระบบกฎหมาย

exhibits.definition: to obey a rule, request, or standard
exhibits.example: To ensure safety, all workers must comply with the company's safety regulations and undergo relevant training.

translations.th_TH: เชื่อฟัง; ที่จะปฏิบัติตาม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 遵守、服從（規則、要求或標準）
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 規則、要求、基準に従う
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 규칙, 요구, 표준을 따르다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: tuân thủ quy định, yêu cầu hoặc tiêu chuẩn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ปฏิบัติตามกฎ คำขอ หรือมาตรฐาน

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 為了確保安全，所有工人必須遵從公司的安全規定，並接受相關的培訓。
exampleTranslations.en_US: To ensure safety, all workers must comply with the company's safety regulations and undergo relevant training.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 安全を確保するため、すべての労働者は会社の安全規則を遵守し、関連する研修を受けなければなりません。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 안전을 보장하기 위해 모든 근로자는 회사의 안전 규정을 준수하고 관련 교육을 받아야 한다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Để bảo đảm an toàn, tất cả công nhân phải tuân thủ các quy định an toàn của công ty và tham gia đào tạo liên quan.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เพื่อให้มั่นใจในความปลอดภัย คนงานทุกคนต้องปฏิบัติตามกฎระเบียบด้านความปลอดภัยของบริษัทและเข้ารับการฝึกอบรมที่เกี่ยวข้อง

exhibits.definition: the legal authority to make decisions over a place or matter
exhibits.example: The dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the state labor board.

translations.vi_VN: thẩm quyền; quyền lực pháp lý
translations.th_TH: เขตอำนาจ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 對某地或某事項作出裁決的法律權限
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: ある地域や事柄について決定を下す法的権限
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 장소나 사안에 대해 결정을 내릴 수 있는 법적 권한
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: thẩm quyền pháp lý để đưa ra quyết định đối với một nơi hoặc vấn đề
definitionTranslations.th_TH: อำนาจตามกฎหมายในการตัดสินใจเกี่ยวกับพื้นที่หรือเรื่องหนึ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 這起爭議由州勞工委員會管轄。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the state labor board.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: この紛争は州労働委員会の管轄下にあります。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 분쟁은 주 노동위원회의 관할에 속한다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Tranh chấp này thuộc thẩm quyền của hội đồng lao động tiểu bang.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ข้อพิพาทนี้อยู่ภายใต้เขตอำนาจของคณะกรรมการแรงงานประจำรัฐ

exhibits.definition: an official rule that forbids something
exhibits.example: To protect public health, the government declared an immediate legal ban prohibiting smoking inside all restaurants.

translations.th_TH: ข้อห้าม; ข้อ จำกัด

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 禁止某事的官方規定
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かを禁止する公式の規則
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 무언가를 금지하는 공식적인 규정
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: một quy định chính thức cấm đoán điều gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: กฎอย่างเป็นทางการที่ห้ามสิ่งใดสิ่งหนึ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 為了保護公眾健康，政府宣佈立即實施禁止在所有餐廳內吸煙的法律禁令。
exampleTranslations.en_US: To protect public health, the government declared an immediate legal ban prohibiting smoking inside all restaurants.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 市民の健康を守るため、政府はすべてのレストラン内での喫煙を禁止する即時法的大禁令を発令しました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 공중 보건을 보호하기 위해 정부는 모든 식당 내 금연을 금지하는 즉각적인 법적 금지령을 선포했습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Để bảo vệ sức khỏe cộng đồng, chính phủ đã tuyên bố lệnh cấm pháp lý có hiệu lực ngay lập tức, cấm hút thuốc bên trong tất cả các nhà hàng.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เพื่อปกป้องสุขภาพของสาธารณชน รัฐบาลได้ประกาศคำสั่งห้ามทางกฎหมายโดยมีผลทันที ห้ามสูบบุหรี่ภายในร้านอาหารทุกแห่ง

exhibits.definition: the act of taking someone into police custody
exhibits.example: Police officers executed a warrant that led to the suspect's formal arrest at his residence.

translations.th_TH: จับกุม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 將某人逮捕並拘留的行為
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 人を警察の拘束下に置くこと
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 누군가를 경찰 구금 상태로 넘기는 행위
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: hành động đưa ai vào sự giam giữ của cảnh sát
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การนำตัวบุคคลเข้าสู่การควบคุมของตำรวจ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 警方執行了搜查令，在嫌疑人的住所將其正式逮捕。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Police officers executed a warrant that led to the suspect's formal arrest at his residence.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 警察官は令状を執行し、容疑者の自宅での正式な逮捕に至りました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 경찰관들은 영장을 집행하여 용의자의 자택에서 정식 체포를 진행했습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Các sĩ quan cảnh sát đã thực thi lệnh bắt giữ dẫn đến việc bắt giữ chính thức nghi phạm tại nơi ở của anh ta.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เจ้าหน้าที่ตำรวจได้นำหมายจับไปดำเนินการส่งผลให้เกิดการจับกุมผู้ต้องหาอย่างเป็นทางการที่บ้านพัก

exhibits.definition: a secret plan by a group to do something harmful or illegal
exhibits.example: The conspiracy in the novel often entangles characters in unexpected plots, captivating the reader's attention.

translations.th_TH: สมรู้ร่วมคิด

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 陰謀，密謀
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 共謀、陰謀
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 음모, 공모
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: âm mưu, cuộc mưu phản
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การสมคบคิด, แผนการลับ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 小說中的陰謀往往讓角色捲入意想不到的情節之中，吸引了讀者的注意。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The conspiracy in the novel often entangles characters in unexpected plots, captivating the reader's attention.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: その小説の陰謀は、登場人物たちを思いがけない筋書きに巻き込み、読者の注意を引きつけることが多い。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 그 소설의 음모는 종종 등장인물들을 예상치 못한 줄거리에 얽어매어 독자의 관심을 사로잡는다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Âm mưu trong tiểu thuyết thường cuốn các nhân vật vào những tình tiết bất ngờ, thu hút sự chú ý của người đọc.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: แผนสมคบคิดในนวนิยายมักพาตัวละครเข้าไปพัวพันกับเหตุการณ์ที่คาดไม่ถึง จนดึงดูดความสนใจของผู้อ่าน

exhibits.definition: to shape metal by heating and hammering it
exhibits.example: Artisans often use forge techniques to create durable and artistic metal items.

translations.th_TH: ตี

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 通過加熱和錘擊使金屬成型
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 加熱して叩くことによって金属を成形すること
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 금속을 가열하고 두드려서 모양을 만드는 것
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: tạo hình kim loại bằng cách nung nóng và rèn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การขึ้นรูปโลหะโดยการให้ความร้อนและตีเหล็ก

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 工匠們經常使用鍛造技術來創造堅固且具有藝術性的金屬物品。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Artisans often use forge techniques to create durable and artistic metal items.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 職人は、丈夫で芸術的な金属製品を作るために、しばしば鍛造技術を使います。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 장인들은 내구성이 뛰어나고 예술적인 금속 제품을 만들기 위해 종종 단조 기술을 사용합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Các nghệ nhân thường sử dụng kỹ thuật rèn để tạo ra những món đồ kim loại bền và mang tính nghệ thuật.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ช่างฝีมือมักใช้เทคนิคการตีขึ้นรูปเพื่อสร้างชิ้นงานโลหะที่ทนทานและมีความเป็นศิลปะ

exhibits.definition: an event involving wrongdoing that causes public anger or shame
exhibits.example: The scandal sparked widespread attention in society and severely damaged the reputation of those involved.

translations.th_TH: เรื่องอื้อฉาว

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 醜聞，醜事
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 世間の怒りや恥を招くような不祥事、スキャンダル
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 대중의 분노나 수치심을 자아내는 부정행위 사건, 스캔들
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: vụ bê bối, tai tiếng (sự việc sai trái gây phẫn nộ hoặc hổ thẹn trong dư luận)
definitionTranslations.th_TH: เรื่องอื้อฉาว (เหตุการณ์ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับการกระทำผิดซึ่งก่อให้เกิดความโกรธหรือความอับอายต่อสาธารณชน)

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 這宗醜聞在社會上引起了廣泛的關注，並導致了當事人的名聲受到嚴重損害。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The scandal sparked widespread attention in society and severely damaged the reputation of those involved.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: そのスキャンダルは社会で広く注目を集め、関係者の評判を著しく損ないました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 그 스캔들은 사회의 폭넓은 관심을 불러일으켰고 관련자들의 평판을 심각하게 훼손했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Vụ bê bối đã gây chú ý rộng rãi trong xã hội và làm tổn hại nghiêm trọng đến danh tiếng của những người liên quan.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เรื่องอื้อฉาวดังกล่าวจุดกระแสความสนใจอย่างกว้างขวางในสังคมและทำลายชื่อเสียงของผู้ที่เกี่ยวข้องอย่างรุนแรง

exhibits.definition: to fail to give proper care or attention to someone or something
exhibits.example: If parents neglect their children's emotional needs, it can lead to long-term effects on their mental health.

translations.th_TH: ละเลย

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 未能適當照顧或注意某人或某事
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 人や物に適切な世話や注意を払わない
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 사람이나 사물에 적절한 보살핌이나 주의를 기울이지 못하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: không chăm sóc hoặc chú ý đúng mức đến ai đó hoặc điều gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ไม่ให้การดูแลหรือความใส่ใจที่เหมาะสมแก่คนหรือสิ่งใด

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 如果家長忽視孩子的情感需求，可能會對他們的心理健康造成長期的影響。
exampleTranslations.en_US: If parents neglect their children's emotional needs, it can lead to long-term effects on their mental health.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 親が子どもの感情的な必要を怠ると、心の健康に長期的な影響を及ぼすことがあります。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 부모가 자녀의 정서적 필요를 소홀히 하면 정신 건강에 장기적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nếu cha mẹ lơ là nhu cầu tình cảm của con cái, điều đó có thể gây ra những ảnh hưởng lâu dài đến sức khỏe tinh thần của chúng.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: หากพ่อแม่ละเลยความต้องการทางอารมณ์ของลูก ก็อาจส่งผลระยะยาวต่อสุขภาพจิตของพวกเขาได้

exhibits.definition: a legal case brought to a court by one party against another
exhibits.example: He filed a lawsuit to recover damages caused by the accident.

translations.th_TH: คดีความ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 訴訟
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 訴訟
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 소송
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: vụ kiện
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การฟ้องร้อง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 他提起了一項訴訟，以追索因事故造成的損失。
exampleTranslations.en_US: He filed a lawsuit to recover damages caused by the accident.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 彼は事故によって生じた損害を回復するために訴訟を起こした。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 그는 사고로 인한 손해를 회복하기 위해 소송을 제기했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Anh ấy đã đệ đơn kiện để đòi bồi thường thiệt hại do tai nạn gây ra.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เขายื่นฟ้องเพื่อเรียกค่าเสียหายจากอุบัติเหตุ

exhibits.definition: a person kept in prison as a punishment for a crime or while waiting for trial
exhibits.example: A prisoner in prison needs to undergo a series of educational and reform programs.

translations.th_TH: inmate; นักโทษ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 因犯罪受罰或候審而被關押在監獄的人
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 犯罪の罰または裁判待ちで刑務所に入れられている人
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 범죄에 대한 처벌이나 재판 대기를 위해 감옥에 갇힌 사람
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: người bị giam trong tù để chịu phạt vì tội phạm hoặc chờ xét xử
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ผู้ที่ถูกคุมขังในเรือนจำเพื่อรับโทษหรือรอการพิจารณาคดี

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 囚犯在獄中需要接受一系列的教育和改造計劃。
exampleTranslations.en_US: A prisoner in prison needs to undergo a series of educational and reform programs.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 刑務所にいる囚人は、一連の教育・更生プログラムを受ける必要があります。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 죄수는 교정 및 교육 프로그램 일련을 거쳐야 합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Một tù nhân trong nhà tù cần phải trải qua một loạt chương trình giáo dục và cải tạo.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: นักโทษในเรือนจำต้องเข้ารับโปรแกรมการศึกษาและการปรับปรุงแก้ไขเป็นชุด

exhibits.definition: the act or process of charging someone with a crime in court
exhibits.example: In court, the lawyers will present a series of evidence to support the prosecution of the defendant.

translations.th_TH: การฟ้องร้อง

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 起訴，檢控，在法庭上控告某人犯罪的行為或過程
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 起訴、告発、訴追
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 기소, 소추
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: sự khởi tố, sự truy tố (trước tòa)
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การฟ้องร้อง, การดำเนินคดีทางอาญา

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在法庭上，律師將提出一系列證據來支持對被告的起訴。
exampleTranslations.en_US: In court, the lawyers will present a series of evidence to support the prosecution of the defendant.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 法廷では、弁護士たちが被告の起訴を裏付けるために一連の証拠を提示します。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 법정에서 변호사들은 피고인의 기소를 뒷받침하기 위해 일련의 증거를 제시할 것입니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Tại tòa, các luật sư sẽ trình bày một loạt bằng chứng để hỗ trợ cho việc truy tố bị cáo.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในศาล ทนายความจะนำเสนอชุดหลักฐานเพื่อสนับสนุนการฟ้องร้องจำเลย

exhibits.definition: a statement of disagreement or opposition
exhibits.example: Raising an objection during a meeting is an important way for participants to express dissenting opinions and enhance discussion.

translations.th_TH: การคัดค้าน

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 表示不同意或反對的陳述
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 不同意や反対を示す発言
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 동의하지 않거나 반대한다는 진술
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: lời bày tỏ sự không đồng ý hoặc phản đối
definitionTranslations.th_TH: คำแถลงที่แสดงความไม่เห็นด้วยหรือคัดค้าน

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在會議上，提出異議是參與者表達不同意見和增加討論的重要方式。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Raising an objection during a meeting is an important way for participants to express dissenting opinions and enhance discussion.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 会議中に異議を唱えることは、参加者が異なる意見を表明し、議論を深めるための重要な方法である。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 회의 중에 이의를 제기하는 것은 참가자들이 반대 의견을 표현하고 토론을 심화하는 중요한 방법이다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Đưa ra phản đối trong cuộc họp là một cách quan trọng để những người tham gia bày tỏ ý kiến trái chiều và làm sâu sắc thêm thảo luận.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: การคัดค้านในที่ประชุมเป็นวิธีสำคัญที่ผู้เข้าร่วมจะแสดงความเห็นที่ไม่ตรงกันและทำให้การอภิปรายลึกซึ้งยิ่งขึ้น

exhibits.definition: an urgent or emotional request
exhibits.example: In court, the defense attorney made a plea hoping the judge would grant leniency to the defendant.

translations.th_TH: คำวิงวอน

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 懇求，哀求，請求
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 懇願、嘆願、熱心な要請
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 간청, 탄원
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: lời khẩn cầu, lời cầu xin
definitionTranslations.th_TH: คำร้องเรียน, คำขอร้องอย่างอ้อนวอน

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在法庭上，辯護律師提出了一項懇求，希望法官能夠給予被告輕判。
exampleTranslations.en_US: In court, the defense attorney made a plea hoping the judge would grant leniency to the defendant.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 法廷で、弁護人は裁判官が被告人に寛大な処置を与えてくれることを願って嘆願しました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 법정에서 변호인은 판사가 피고인에게 관용을 베풀어 주기를 바라며 탄원했습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Tại tòa, luật sư bào chữa đã đưa ra lời thỉnh cầu, hy vọng thẩm phán sẽ khoan hồng cho bị cáo.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในศาล ทนายฝ่ายจำเลยได้ยื่นคำร้องขอความเมตตา โดยหวังว่าผู้พิพากษาจะผ่อนปรนโทษให้จำเลย

exhibits.definition: an official decision made by a jury or judge
exhibits.example: The jury's verdict will be announced at the conclusion of the case, and this decision will have a significant impact on all parties involved.

translations.th_TH: คำพิพากษา

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: （陪審團或法官的）裁決、判決
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: （陪審員または裁判官による）評決、判決
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: （배심원이나 판사의） 판결, 평결
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: phán quyết (chính thức của bồi thẩm đoàn hoặc thẩm phán)
definitionTranslations.th_TH: คำตัดสินของคณะลูกขุนหรือผู้พิพากษา

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 陪審團的裁決將在案件結束時公佈，這一結果將對所有涉案人產生重大影響。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The jury's verdict will be announced at the conclusion of the case, and this decision will have a significant impact on all parties involved.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 陪審の評決は事件の結論時に発表され、この決定は関係するすべての当事者に大きな影響を与える。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 배심원의 평결은 사건이 끝날 때 발표될 것이며, 이 결정은 관련된 모든 당사자에게 중대한 영향을 미칠 것입니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Phán quyết của bồi thẩm đoàn sẽ được công bố khi kết thúc vụ án, và quyết định này sẽ có tác động đáng kể đối với tất cả các bên liên quan.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: คำตัดสินของคณะลูกขุนจะได้รับการประกาศเมื่อสิ้นสุดคดี และการตัดสินใจนี้จะมีผลกระทบอย่างมากต่อทุกฝ่ายที่เกี่ยวข้อง

exhibits.definition: a formal promise to tell the truth or do something
exhibits.example: In court, witnesses must take an oath to ensure that what they say is truthful.

translations.th_TH: คำสาบาน; จำนำ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 說實話或做某事的正式承諾
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 真実を述べる、または何かを行う正式な誓い
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 진실을 말하거나 무언가를 하겠다는 공식적인 맹세
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: lời hứa trang trọng để nói sự thật hoặc làm điều gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: คำสัญญาอย่างเป็นทางการว่าจะพูดความจริงหรือทำบางสิ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在法庭上，證人必須宣誓，發表他們的誓言，以保證他們所說的是真實的。
exampleTranslations.en_US: In court, witnesses must take an oath to ensure that what they say is truthful.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 裁判で、証人は自分の言うことが真実であることを保証するために誓いを立てなければなりません。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 법정에서 증인은 자신이 말하는 내용이 진실임을 보장하기 위해 서약을 해야 한다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Tại tòa, các nhân chứng phải tuyên thệ để bảo đảm rằng những gì họ nói là trung thực.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในศาล พยานต้องกล่าวคำสาบานเพื่อให้มั่นใจว่าพวกเขาพูดความจริง

exhibits.definition: a formal written agreement between countries or governments
exhibits.example: Historically, many countries have reached peace agreements through the signing of a treaty, which has profound effects on international relations.

translations.th_TH: สนธิสัญญา

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 條約
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 条約
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 조약
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: hiệp ước
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สนธิสัญญา

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 歷史上，許多國家通過簽署條約來達成和平協議，這對國際關係有著深遠的影響。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Historically, many countries have reached peace agreements through the signing of a treaty, which has profound effects on international relations.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 歴史的に、多くの国々は条約の締結を通じて平和協定に達しており、それは国際関係に深い影響を及ぼしています。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 역사적으로 많은 나라들은 조약 체결을 통해 평화 협정에 이르렀고, 이는 국제 관계에 깊은 영향을 미칩니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Về mặt lịch sử, nhiều quốc gia đã đạt được các thỏa thuận hòa bình thông qua việc ký kết một hiệp ước, và điều đó có ảnh hưởng sâu sắc đến quan hệ quốc tế.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในทางประวัติศาสตร์ หลายประเทศได้บรรลุข้อตกลงสันติภาพผ่านการลงนามในสนธิสัญญา ซึ่งส่งผลอย่างลึกซึ้งต่อความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างประเทศ

exhibits.definition: a written law formally passed by a legislative body
exhibits.example: The legislature passed a new statute to regulate the behavior of online transactions.

translations.th_TH: กฎเกณฑ์

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 由立法機關正式通過的成文法律
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 立法機関が正式に可決した成文法
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 입법 기관이 공식 통과시킨 성문법
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: luật thành văn được cơ quan lập pháp chính thức thông qua
definitionTranslations.th_TH: กฎหมายลายลักษณ์อักษรที่ผ่านโดยสภานิติบัญญัติอย่างเป็นทางการ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 國會通過了一項新的法令，以規範線上交易的行為。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The legislature passed a new statute to regulate the behavior of online transactions.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 立法府はオンライン取引の行動を規制する新しい法令を可決した。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 입법부는 온라인 거래의 행동을 규제하기 위해 새로운 법령을 통과시켰습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Cơ quan lập pháp đã thông qua một điều luật mới để điều chỉnh hành vi của các giao dịch trực tuyến.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: สภานิติบัญญัติได้ผ่านกฎหมายฉบับใหม่เพื่อควบคุมพฤติกรรมของธุรกรรมออนไลน์

exhibits.definition: not required to follow a rule, pay a charge, or do a duty
exhibits.example: Under the new policy, certain beneficiaries can be exempt from paying certain taxes, providing them with financial relief.

translations.th_TH: ยกเว้น

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 無須遵守規則、付費或履行義務的
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 規則・支払い・義務を免除された
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 규칙 준수, 요금 납부, 의무 수행이 면제된
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: không phải tuân theo quy định, trả phí hoặc làm nghĩa vụ
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ได้รับการยกเว้นจากกฎ ค่าธรรมเนียม หรือหน้าที่

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 根據這項新政策，某些受助者可以免除繳納部分稅款，這為他們帶來了經濟上的舒緩。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Under the new policy, certain beneficiaries can be exempt from paying certain taxes, providing them with financial relief.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 新しい方針の下で、特定の受益者は特定の税金の支払いから免除されることがあり、その結果、経済的な支援を受けることができます。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 새 정책에 따라 일부 수혜자는 특정 세금을 내지 않아도 되어 재정적 부담을 덜 수 있습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Theo chính sách mới, một số người thụ hưởng có thể được miễn nộp một số loại thuế, giúp họ bớt gánh nặng tài chính.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ภายใต้นโยบายใหม่ ผู้รับผลประโยชน์บางรายสามารถได้รับการยกเว้นไม่ต้องจ่ายภาษีบางประเภท ซึ่งช่วยบรรเทาภาระทางการเงินของพวกเขา

exhibits.definition: to break a law, rule, agreement, or standard
exhibits.example: If you violate the terms of the contract, you may face legal consequences.

translations.th_TH: ละเมิด

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 違反法律、規則、協議或標準
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 法律、規則、合意、基準に違反する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 법, 규칙, 합의, 기준을 어기다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: vi phạm luật, quy tắc, thỏa thuận hoặc tiêu chuẩn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ฝ่าฝืนกฎหมาย กฎ ข้อตกลง หรือมาตรฐาน

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 如果你違反了合約中的條款，你可能會面臨法律後果。
exampleTranslations.en_US: If you violate the terms of the contract, you may face legal consequences.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 契約条件に違反すると、法的な結果に直面する可能性がある。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 계약 조건을 위반하면 법적 결과에 직면할 수 있다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nếu bạn vi phạm các điều khoản của hợp đồng, bạn có thể phải đối mặt với hậu quả pháp lý.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: หากคุณละเมิดเงื่อนไขของสัญญา คุณอาจเผชิญผลทางกฎหมายได้

exhibits.definition: the state or punishment of being kept in prison
exhibits.example: imprisonment can have profound effects on a person's mental health, especially when isolated from the outside world for long periods.

translations.th_TH: การจำคุก; การคุมขัง

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 被關在監獄中的狀態或懲罰
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 刑務所に拘禁される状態または刑罰
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 감옥에 갇힌 상태나 처벌
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: tình trạng hoặc hình phạt bị giữ trong tù
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สภาพหรือโทษของการถูกขังในคุก

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 監禁會對人的心理健康產生深遠的影響，尤其是在長時間與外界隔絕的情況下。
exampleTranslations.en_US: imprisonment can have profound effects on a person's mental health, especially when isolated from the outside world for long periods.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 投獄は人の精神衛生に深刻な影響を及ぼすことがあり、特に長期間外の世界から隔離されるとその影響は大きい。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 수감은 한 사람의 정신 건강에 깊은 영향을 미칠 수 있으며, 특히 오랜 기간 외부 세계와 단절될 때 더욱 그렇다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Việc bị giam cầm có thể gây ra những tác động sâu sắc đến sức khỏe tâm thần của một người, đặc biệt là khi bị cách ly khỏi thế giới bên ngoài trong thời gian dài.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: การถูกคุมขังอาจส่งผลอย่างลึกซึ้งต่อสุขภาพจิตของคนคนหนึ่ง โดยเฉพาะเมื่อถูกแยกจากโลกภายนอกเป็นเวลานาน

exhibits.definition: an interruption or disruption that stops normal activity or calm
exhibits.example: In the classroom, the disturbance caused the teacher to repeat important lessons to ensure everyone understood.

translations.th_TH: ความวุ่นวาย

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 中斷正常活動或平靜的干擾
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 通常の活動や平穏を止める中断や妨害
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 정상적인 활동이나 평온을 멈추게 하는 방해나 혼란
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: sự gián đoạn hoặc xáo trộn làm ngừng hoạt động bình thường hoặc sự yên tĩnh
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การขัดจังหวะหรือรบกวนที่ทำให้กิจกรรมปกติหรือความสงบหยุดลง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在課堂上，學生的干擾導致教師不得不重複重要的教學內容，以確保每個人都能理解。
exampleTranslations.en_US: In the classroom, the disturbance caused the teacher to repeat important lessons to ensure everyone understood.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 教室では、その騒ぎのせいで先生は、全員が理解できるように重要な授業を繰り返さなければなりませんでした。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 교실에서의 소란 때문에 선생님은 모두가 이해할 수 있도록 중요한 수업을 반복해야 했습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong lớp học, sự náo động khiến giáo viên phải lặp lại những bài học quan trọng để bảo đảm mọi người đều hiểu.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในห้องเรียน ความวุ่นวายทำให้ครูต้องสอนบทเรียนสำคัญซ้ำอีกครั้งเพื่อให้ทุกคนเข้าใจ

exhibits.definition: a statement admitting that one has done something wrong or illegal
exhibits.example: During the police investigation, the suspect's confession played a crucial role in determining the course of events.

translations.th_TH: การสารภาพ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 承認自己做了錯事或違法行為的聲明
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 自身が誤ったことや違法なことをしたと認める声明
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 자신이 잘못되었거나 불법적인 일을 했음을 인정하는 성명
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: lời khai thừa nhận mình đã làm điều gì đó sai trái hoặc bất hợp pháp
definitionTranslations.th_TH: คำสารภาพที่ยอมรับว่าตนได้กระทำความผิดหรือสิ่งผิดกฎหมาย

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在警方的調查過程中，嫌疑人的供詞起到了關鍵性的作用，幫助確定了事發經過。
exampleTranslations.en_US: During the police investigation, the suspect's confession played a crucial role in determining the course of events.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 警察の捜査中、容疑者の自白が事件の展開を決定するうえで重要な役割を果たした。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 경찰 수사 중에 용의자의 자백은 사건의 전개를 결정하는 데 중요한 역할을 했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong cuộc điều tra của cảnh sát, lời thú nhận của nghi phạm đã đóng vai trò then chốt trong việc xác định diễn biến của vụ việc.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ระหว่างการสืบสวนของตำรวจ คำรับสารภาพของผู้ต้องสงสัยมีบทบาทสำคัญอย่างยิ่งในการกำหนดลำดับเหตุการณ์

exhibits.definition: to inflict a penalty on someone for an offense, crime, or misconduct
exhibits.example: The school needs to take appropriate measures to punish students for violating rules in order to maintain discipline.

translations.th_TH: ลงโทษ；เอาผิด

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 因過錯、犯罪或不當行為而對某人施加懲罰
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 違反、犯罪、または不正行為に対して誰かに罰を科す
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 위반, 범죄 또는 부정행위에 대해 누군가에게 처벌을 가하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: áp đặt hình phạt lên ai đó vì lỗi, tội phạm hoặc hành vi sai trái
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ลงโทษบุคคลจากความผิด อาชญากรรม หรือการประพฤติมิชอบ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 對於不遵守規則的行為，學校需要採取適當的措施來懲罰學生，以維護紀律。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The school needs to take appropriate measures to punish students for violating rules in order to maintain discipline.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 学校は規律を維持するために、規則を破った生徒を適切に罰する措置を取る必要がある。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 학교는 규칙을 위반한 학생들을 징계하기 위해 적절한 조치를 취해 질서를 유지할 필요가 있다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nhà trường cần áp dụng các biện pháp phù hợp để trừng phạt học sinh vì vi phạm nội quy nhằm duy trì kỷ luật.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: โรงเรียนจำเป็นต้องใช้มาตรการที่เหมาะสมเพื่อลงโทษนักเรียนที่ละเมิดกฎเพื่อรักษาระเบียบวินัย

exhibits.definition: to admit something honestly, especially something private or wrong
exhibits.example: Feeling guilty about taking the money, the suspect decided to confess to the police and admit his crime.

translations.th_TH: สารภาพ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 誠實承認某事，尤其是私事或錯事
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 特に私的なことや過ちを正直に認める
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 특히 사적인 일이나 잘못을 솔직히 인정하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: thành thật thừa nhận điều gì, nhất là chuyện riêng tư hoặc sai trái
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ยอมรับบางสิ่งอย่างซื่อสัตย์ โดยเฉพาะเรื่องส่วนตัวหรือความผิด

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 嫌疑犯對拿了錢感到愧疚，決定向警方坦白並承認自己的罪行。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Feeling guilty about taking the money, the suspect decided to confess to the police and admit his crime.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: お金を取ったことに罪悪感を覚えた容疑者は、警察に自白して罪を認めることにしました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 돈을 가져간 것에 대해 죄책감을 느낀 피의자는 경찰에 자백하고 자신의 범죄를 인정하기로 결심했습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Cảm thấy có lỗi vì đã lấy tiền, nghi phạm quyết định thú nhận với cảnh sát và thừa nhận tội lỗi của mình.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เนื่องจากรู้สึกผิดที่เอาเงินไป ผู้ต้องสงสัยจึงตัดสินใจสารภาพต่อตำรวจและยอมรับความผิดของตน

exhibits.definition: a state of being harmless, pure, or free from guilt
exhibits.example: Protecting children’s innocence from the harms of the outside world is a responsibility of every society.

translations.th_TH: ความบริสุทธิ์; การไม่มีความผิด

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 無害、純真或無罪的狀態
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 無害、純粋、または罪がない状態
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 해롭지 않고 순수하거나 죄가 없는 상태
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: trạng thái vô hại, trong sạch hoặc không có tội
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สภาพที่ไม่เป็นอันตราย บริสุทธิ์ หรือปราศจากความผิด

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 保護兒童的無辜，使他們免受外界的傷害，是每個社會的責任。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Protecting children’s innocence from the harms of the outside world is a responsibility of every society.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 子どもたちの無垢を外の世界の害から守ることは、あらゆる社会の責任です。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 아이들의 순수함을 바깥세상의 해로움으로부터 지키는 것은 모든 사회의 책임입니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Bảo vệ sự ngây thơ của trẻ em khỏi những tác hại của thế giới bên ngoài là trách nhiệm của mọi xã hội.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: การปกป้องความบริสุทธิ์ของเด็กๆ จากอันตรายของโลกภายนอกเป็นความรับผิดชอบของทุกสังคม

exhibits.definition: an earlier example or decision used as a guide for later cases
exhibits.example: This case may set an important precedent for future legal rulings, impacting the decisions of similar cases going forward.

translations.th_TH: บรรทัดฐาน

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 作為後續案件指引的先前例子或決定
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 後の事例の指針となる以前の例や決定
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 이후 사례의 지침으로 쓰이는 이전의 예나 결정
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: ví dụ hoặc quyết định trước đó dùng làm hướng dẫn cho các trường hợp sau
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ตัวอย่างหรือคำตัดสินก่อนหน้าที่ใช้เป็นแนวทางสำหรับกรณีภายหลัง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 這個案件可能會成為未來法律判決的重要先例，影響今後類似案例的裁決。
exampleTranslations.en_US: This case may set an important precedent for future legal rulings, impacting the decisions of similar cases going forward.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: この事件は将来の法的判決において重要な前例を設定する可能性があり、今後の類似のケースの判断に影響を与えます。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 사건은 향후 법적 판결에 중요한 판례가 될 수 있으며, 앞으로 비슷한 사건들의 결정에도 영향을 미칠 것입니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Vụ án này có thể đặt ra một tiền lệ quan trọng cho các phán quyết pháp lý trong tương lai, ảnh hưởng đến quyết định của những vụ việc tương tự sau này.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: กรณีนี้อาจสร้างบรรทัดฐานสำคัญสำหรับคำตัดสินทางกฎหมายในอนาคต ซึ่งจะส่งผลต่อการตัดสินใจของกรณีที่คล้ายกันต่อไป

exhibits.definition: a strong feeling that someone or something is worthless or not deserving respect
exhibits.example: There is a prevailing sense of contempt in society towards those who disrespect legal regulations, as it violates social morals.

translations.th_TH: ความดูถูก

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 強烈感到某人或某物毫無價值或不值得尊重
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 誰かや何かが無価値である、あるいは尊敬に値しないという強い感情
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 누군가 또는 무언가가 무가치하거나 존중받을 가치가 없다는 강한 감정
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: cảm giác mạnh mẽ rằng ai đó hoặc cái gì đó vô giá trị hoặc không đáng được tôn trọng
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ความรู้สึกรุนแรงว่าคนหรือบางสิ่งไม่มีค่าหรือไม่สมควรได้รับความเคารพ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 對於那些不尊重法律規則的人，社會普遍存在著蔑視的情緒，因為這違反了社會公德。
exampleTranslations.en_US: There is a prevailing sense of contempt in society towards those who disrespect legal regulations, as it violates social morals.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 法的規制を軽視する者たちに対して、社会には軽蔑の念が広く根付いており、それは社会道徳に反するためである。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 법적 규정을 무시하는 사람들에 대해 사회 전반에 경멸의 감정이 널리 퍼져 있다. 그것은 사회 도덕에 어긋나기 때문이다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong xã hội đang tồn tại một cảm giác khinh miệt mạnh mẽ đối với những người coi thường các quy định pháp luật, vì điều đó đi ngược lại đạo đức xã hội.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในสังคมมีความรู้สึกดูหมิ่นเหยียดหยามอย่างแพร่หลายต่อผู้ที่ไม่เคารพกฎระเบียบทางกฎหมาย เพราะนั่นขัดต่อศีลธรรมของสังคม

exhibits.definition: the action of forgiving or being forgiven for an error or offense
exhibits.example: He hoped to receive her pardon, as he realized he had made a mistake.

translations.th_TH: ขออภัย

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 原諒或因錯誤、冒犯而被原諒的行為
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 過ちや違反を許すこと、または許されること
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 실수나 잘못에 대해 용서하거나 용서받는 행위
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: hành động tha thứ hoặc được tha thứ vì lỗi lầm hay sự xúc phạm
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การให้อภัยหรือได้รับการให้อภัยจากความผิดหรือการล่วงเกิน

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 他希望能夠得到她的原諒，因為他意識到自己犯了錯。
exampleTranslations.en_US: He hoped to receive her pardon, as he realized he had made a mistake.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 彼は自分が間違いを犯したことに気づいたので、彼女の承認を受けたいと思った。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 그는 자신의 실수를 깨닫고 그녀의 용서를 받기를 바랐다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Anh ấy hy vọng sẽ nhận được sự tha thứ của cô ấy, vì anh nhận ra mình đã mắc lỗi.

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 懇願する、嘆願する

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Anh ấy đứng trước thẩm phán để khẩn cầu lòng thương xót, tin rằng đây là cơ hội duy nhất của mình.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เขายืนต่อหน้าผู้พิพากษาเพื่อวิงวอนขอความเมตตา โดยเชื่อว่านี่เป็นโอกาสเดียวของเขา

exhibits.definition: to officially accuse someone of a crime and take the case to court
exhibits.example: In criminal cases, the prosecutor is responsible to prosecute the defendant to ensure justice is served.

translations.th_TH: ดำเนินคดี

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong các vụ án hình sự, công tố viên có trách nhiệm truy tố bị cáo để bảo đảm công lý được thực thi.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในคดีอาญา อัยการมีหน้าที่ดำเนินคดีกับจำเลยเพื่อให้ความยุติธรรมเกิดขึ้น

exhibits.definition: to make people obey a law, rule, or decision

exampleTranslations.en_US: Police monitor the road to enforce the legal speed limit.

exampleTranslations.th_TH: ตำรวจกำลังเฝ้าระวังถนนเพื่อปฏิบัติตามข้อจำกัดความเร็วตามกฎหมาย

exhibits.definition: a rule or piece of advice that helps people decide what to do
exhibits.example: Following this guideline will help us maintain consistency in our research projects.

translations.th_TH: แนวทาง

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 人々が行動を決めるのに役立つ規則やアドバイス
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 행동 결정을 돕는 규칙이나 권고 사항
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: quy tắc hoặc lời khuyên giúp mọi người quyết định nên làm gì

exhibits.definition: to officially give permission or power to do something

definitionTranslations.vi_VN: chính thức cấp phép hoặc trao quyền để làm điều gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ให้สิทธิ์หรืออำนาจอย่างเป็นทางการในการทำบางสิ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 董事會成員必須授權發放資金，施工項目才能開始。

exhibits.definition: someone who enters a place without permission

exhibits.definition: failing to take the care that a situation requires

exhibits.definition: the illegal seizure of a vehicle, aircraft, or system by force

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Vụ không tặc đó đã gây tổn hại tâm lý to lớn cho những hành khách vô tội và có tác động lâu dài đến toàn xã hội.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เหตุการณ์จี้เครื่องบินนั้นก่อให้เกิดความเสียหายทางจิตใจอย่างมหาศาลแก่ผู้โดยสารผู้บริสุทธิ์ และส่งผลกระทบยาวนานต่อสังคมโดยรวม

exhibits.definition: to cause someone to believe something that is not true

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 真実でないことを信じさせる
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 사실이 아닌 것을 믿게 하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: khiến ai đó tin điều không đúng
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ทำให้ใครบางคนเชื่อสิ่งที่ไม่เป็นจริง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 一些廣告可能會誤導消費者，讓他們對產品有不實的期望。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Some advertisements may mislead consumers, creating unrealistic expectations about a product.

exampleTranslations.th_TH: โฆษณาบางชิ้นอาจทำให้ผู้บริโภคเข้าใจผิด และสร้างความคาดหวังที่ไม่สมจริงเกี่ยวกับผลิตภัณฑ์

exhibits.definition: to say that someone has done something wrong or illegal

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 誰かが悪いことや違法なことをしたと言う
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 누군가가 잘못되거나 불법적인 일을 했다고 말하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: nói rằng ai đó đã làm điều sai trái hoặc bất hợp pháp
definitionTranslations.th_TH: กล่าวว่าคนใดคนหนึ่งทำสิ่งผิดหรือผิดกฎหมาย

exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 재판 중에 검사는 피고의 유죄를 입증하기 위해 피고를 고발할 충분한 근거를 제시해야 합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong phiên tòa, công tố viên cần đưa ra đủ căn cứ để buộc tội bị cáo nhằm chứng minh tội lỗi của họ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ระหว่างการพิจารณาคดี อัยการจำเป็นต้องมีเหตุผลเพียงพอที่จะกล่าวหาจำเลยเพื่อพิสูจน์ความผิดของเขา

exhibits.definition: a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal
exhibits.example: The accusation against him lacked evidence, leading to his acquittal.

translations.th_TH: ค่าใช้จ่าย; ข้อกล่าวหา

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 指稱某人做錯事或違法的陳述
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 誰かが不正または違法なことをしたと述べること
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 누군가가 잘못이나 불법 행위를 했다고 말하는 진술
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: lời nói cho rằng ai đó đã làm điều sai trái hoặc bất hợp pháp
definitionTranslations.th_TH: คำกล่าวว่าบางคนทำสิ่งผิดหรือผิดกฎหมาย

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 對他的指控缺乏證據，因此他被宣告無罪。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The accusation against him lacked evidence, leading to his acquittal.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 彼に対する告発には証拠がなく、その結果、彼は無罪となった。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 그에 대한 고발에는 증거가 부족해, 그는 무죄를 선고받았다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Lời buộc tội nhằm vào anh ta thiếu bằng chứng, dẫn đến việc anh được tuyên trắng án.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ข้อกล่าวหาต่อเขาขาดหลักฐาน จนนำไปสู่การพ้นผิดของเขา

exhibits.definition: to call someone to come or be present
exhibits.example: In case of emergency, they were instructed to immediately summon the medical team for assistance.

translations.th_TH: เรียก

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 叫某人前來或出席
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 人を呼んで来させる、出席させる
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 누군가를 오거나 참석하도록 부르다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: gọi ai đó đến hoặc có mặt
definitionTranslations.th_TH: เรียกให้ใครบางคนมาหรือเข้าร่วม

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在緊急情況下，他們被要求立刻召喚醫療隊以提供幫助。
exampleTranslations.en_US: In case of emergency, they were instructed to immediately summon the medical team for assistance.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 緊急時には、彼らは直ちに医療チームに援助を求めるよう指示されていた。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 비상시에는 즉시 의료팀에 도움을 요청하도록 지시받았다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong trường hợp khẩn cấp, họ được hướng dẫn lập tức triệu tập đội ngũ y tế để hỗ trợ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในกรณีฉุกเฉิน พวกเขาได้รับคำสั่งให้รีบเรียกทีมแพทย์มาช่วยเหลือ

exhibits.definition: to claim that something is true, especially without proving it
exhibits.example: Prosecutors allege that the suspect committed fraud, though no hard evidence has been presented yet.

translations.th_TH: กล่าวหา

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 聲稱某事為真，尤指未加證明
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 特に証明せずに、何かが真実だと主張すること
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 특히 입증하지 않고 무엇이 사실이라고 주장하는 것
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: khẳng định điều gì đó là đúng, nhất là khi chưa chứng minh
definitionTranslations.th_TH: อ้างว่าสิ่งใดเป็นจริง โดยเฉพาะเมื่อยังไม่ได้พิสูจน์

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 檢察官指控嫌犯涉嫌詐欺，儘管目前尚未提出確鑿的證據。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Prosecutors allege that the suspect committed fraud, though no hard evidence has been presented yet.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 検察官は容疑者が詐欺を行ったと主張しているが、まだ確たる証拠は提示されていない。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 검찰은 피의자가 사기를 저질렀다고 주장하지만, 아직 확실한 증거는 제시되지 않았다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Các công tố viên cáo buộc rằng nghi phạm đã phạm tội gian lận, mặc dù chưa có bằng chứng xác thực nào được đưa ra.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: อัยการกล่าวหาว่าผู้ต้องสงสัยกระทำการทุจริต แม้ว่ายังไม่มีการนำเสนอหลักฐานที่แน่ชัดก็ตาม

exhibits.definition: to officially or forcefully change or reject an existing decision, system, or idea
exhibits.example: The emergence of social movements has begun to overturn outdated notions, prompting a reevaluation of identity and power issues.

translations.th_TH: ล้มล้าง

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 撤銷，推翻，廢除（決定、系統或觀念）
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 覆す、無効にする（決定・制度・考えなどを公式に、または強制的に）
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 뒤집다, 번복하다 (결정, 제도, 생각 등을 공식적이거나 강제적으로)
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: lật ngược, bác bỏ, hủy bỏ (quyết định, hệ thống hoặc ý kiến)
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ล้มล้าง, ยกเลิก, คว่ำ (คำตัดสิน, ระบบ หรือแนวคิด)

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 社會運動的出現推翻了舊有的觀念，引導人們重新思考身份和權力的問題。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The emergence of social movements has begun to overturn outdated notions, prompting a reevaluation of identity and power issues.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 社会運動の台頭は時代遅れの考えを覆し始め、アイデンティティと権力の問題の再考を促している。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 사회운동의 등장으로 시대에 뒤떨어진 개념들이 뒤집히기 시작했으며, 정체성과 권력 문제를 다시 생각하게 하고 있습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Sự xuất hiện của các phong trào xã hội đã bắt đầu lật đổ những quan niệm lỗi thời, thúc đẩy việc xem xét lại các vấn đề về bản sắc và quyền lực.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: การเกิดขึ้นของขบวนการทางสังคมได้เริ่มพลิกคว่ำแนวคิดล้าสมัย กระตุ้นให้มีการทบทวนประเด็นเรื่องอัตลักษณ์และอำนาจใหม่

exhibits.definition: to settle a disagreement by making a neutral decision
exhibits.example: A neutral consultant was hired to arbitrate the contract dispute between the two vendors.

translations.th_TH: ตัดสินชี้ขาด

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 以中立決定解決分歧
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 中立的な判断で意見の相違を解決する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 중립적인 결정으로 의견 차이를 해결하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: giải quyết bất đồng bằng quyết định trung lập
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ยุติความขัดแย้งด้วยการตัดสินอย่างเป็นกลาง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 公司聘請了一位中立顧問來仲裁兩家供應商之間的合約爭議。
exampleTranslations.en_US: A neutral consultant was hired to arbitrate the contract dispute between the two vendors.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: その会社は、2つの業者間の契約紛争を仲裁するために中立のコンサルタントを雇いました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 중립적인 컨설턴트가 두 공급업체 사이의 계약 분쟁을 중재하도록 고용되었다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Một cố vấn trung lập đã được thuê để phân xử tranh chấp hợp đồng giữa hai nhà cung cấp.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: มีการจ้างที่ปรึกษาที่เป็นกลางมาเป็นอนุญาโตตุลาการข้อพิพาทสัญญาระหว่างผู้ขายทั้งสองราย

exhibits.definition: to officially forbid something by rule or law
exhibits.example: School regulations clearly prohibit smoking on campus to ensure students' health.

translations.th_TH: ห้าม; ที่จะห้าม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 禁止，以法規或法律正式禁止某事
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 禁止する、法的に禁止する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 금지하다, 법으로 금하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: cấm, ngăn cấm (bằng quy định hoặc luật pháp)
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ห้าม, สั่งห้าม (โดยกฎหมายหรือระเบียบข้อบังคับ)

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 校規明確禁止在校內吸煙，以保障學生的健康。
exampleTranslations.en_US: School regulations clearly prohibit smoking on campus to ensure students' health.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 校則は、学生の健康を守るため、キャンパス内での喫煙を明確に禁止しています。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 학교 규정은 학생들의 건강을 보장하기 위해 캠퍼스 내 흡연을 명확히 금지합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Quy định của trường rõ ràng cấm hút thuốc trong khuôn viên để bảo đảm sức khỏe của học sinh.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ระเบียบของโรงเรียนห้ามสูบบุหรี่ในบริเวณวิทยาเขตอย่างชัดเจนเพื่อให้แน่ใจว่านักเรียนมีสุขภาพดี

exhibits.definition: allowed by law
exhibits.example: All commercial transactions must be conducted within lawful boundaries to ensure the rights of businesses and consumers are protected.

translations.th_TH: ถูกกฎหมาย; ถูกต้องตามกฎหมาย

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 法律允許的
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 法律で認められた
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 법으로 허용된
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: được pháp luật cho phép
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ได้รับอนุญาตตามกฎหมาย

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 所有的商業交易都必須在合法的範疇內進行，以確保企業和消費者的權益不受侵害。
exampleTranslations.en_US: All commercial transactions must be conducted within lawful boundaries to ensure the rights of businesses and consumers are protected.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: すべての商取引は、企業と消費者の権利が守られるよう、法にかなった範囲内で行われなければなりません。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 모든 상거래는 기업과 소비자의 권리가 보호되도록 합법적인 범위 내에서 이루어져야 합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Mọi giao dịch thương mại phải được thực hiện trong khuôn khổ hợp pháp để bảo đảm quyền lợi của doanh nghiệp và người tiêu dùng được bảo vệ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ธุรกรรมทางการค้าทั้งหมดต้องดำเนินการภายในขอบเขตที่ชอบด้วยกฎหมาย เพื่อให้แน่ใจว่าสิทธิของธุรกิจและผู้บริโภคได้รับการคุ้มครอง

exhibits.definition: allowed by rules, law, or accepted standards
exhibits.example: Drivers must strictly obey the maximum permissible speed limit displayed on road signs.

translations.th_TH: ได้รับอนุญาต; ยอมรับได้

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 規則、法律或公認標準所允許的
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 規則、法律、または認められた基準で許される
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 규칙, 법률 또는 인정된 기준에 의해 허용되는
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: được cho phép theo quy tắc, pháp luật hoặc tiêu chuẩn được chấp nhận
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ได้รับอนุญาตตามกฎ กฎหมาย หรือมาตรฐานที่ยอมรับ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 駕駛人必須嚴格遵守道路標誌上顯示的最大允許最高限速。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Drivers must strictly obey the maximum permissible speed limit displayed on road signs.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: ドライバーは道路標識に表示されている最大許容速度制限を厳格に遵守しなければなりません。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 운전자는 도로 표지판에 표시된 최대 허용 속도 제한을 엄격히 준수해야 합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Người lái xe phải nghiêm chỉnh chấp hành giới hạn tốc độ tối đa cho phép hiển thị trên biển báo giao thông.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ผู้ขับขี่ต้องปฏิบัติตามขีดจำกัดความเร็วสูงสุดที่อนุญาตให้ใช้ซึ่งแสดงบนป้ายจราจรอย่างเคร่งครัด

exhibits.definition: to officially end a law, system, or practice
exhibits.example: Many activists are striving to urge Congress to abolish laws that are seen as unjust, fostering societal harmony.

translations.th_TH: จบ; ที่จะยกเลิก

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 正式廢除法律、制度或做法
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 法律、制度、または慣行を正式に廃止する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 법, 제도, 관행을 공식적으로 폐지하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: chính thức chấm dứt một luật, hệ thống hoặc thông lệ
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ยกเลิกกฎหมาย ระบบ หรือแนวปฏิบัติอย่างเป็นทางการ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 許多運動家都在努力要求國會廢除那些視為不公的法律，這樣可以促進社會的和諧。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Many activists are striving to urge Congress to abolish laws that are seen as unjust, fostering societal harmony.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 多くの活動家は、不当だと見なされている法律を廃止するよう議会に促そうと努力し、社会の調和を育んでいる。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 많은 활동가들이 부당하다고 여겨지는 법을 폐지하도록 의회에 촉구하려고 애쓰고 있으며, 이는 사회적 조화를 이루는 데 도움이 된다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nhiều nhà hoạt động đang nỗ lực thúc giục Quốc hội bãi bỏ những đạo luật bị xem là bất công, qua đó thúc đẩy sự hòa hợp xã hội.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: นักเคลื่อนไหวจำนวนมากกำลังพยายามเร่งเร้าให้สภาคองเกรสยกเลิกกฎหมายที่ถูกมองว่าไม่เป็นธรรม เพื่อส่งเสริมความกลมเกลียวในสังคม

exhibits.definition: a strong official effort to stop illegal or unwanted activity
exhibits.example: The government's crackdown on criminal activities has significantly reduced the crime rate in the area.

translations.th_TH: การยึด; การปราบปราม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 官方為制止非法或不受歡迎活動而採取的強力行動
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 違法または望ましくない活動を止めるための強い公的取り締まり
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 불법적이거나 원치 않는 활동을 막기 위한 강력한 공식 단속
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: nỗ lực chính thức mạnh mẽ nhằm ngăn chặn hoạt động bất hợp pháp hoặc không mong muốn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ความพยายามอย่างเข้มงวดของทางการเพื่อหยุดกิจกรรมผิดกฎหมายหรือไม่พึงประสงค์

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 政府對於犯罪活動的鎮壓行動顯著降低了該地區的犯罪率。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The government's crackdown on criminal activities has significantly reduced the crime rate in the area.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 政府による犯罪行為への取り締まりによって、その地域の犯罪率は大幅に下がりました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 정부의 범죄 행위에 대한 단속으로 그 지역의 범죄율이 크게 낮아졌습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Cuộc trấn áp của chính phủ đối với các hoạt động tội phạm đã làm giảm đáng kể tỷ lệ tội phạm trong khu vực.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: การปราบปรามกิจกรรมอาชญากรรมของรัฐบาลได้ช่วยลดอัตราอาชญากรรมในพื้นที่ลงอย่างมาก

exhibits.definition: the crime or act of taking someone away by force
exhibits.example: The police swiftly developed a plan to respond to the child's kidnap case, to ensure safety.

translations.th_TH: การลักพาตัว

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 綁架
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 誘拐
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 납치
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: sự bắt cóc
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การลักพาตัว

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 警方迅速制定計劃以應對孩子的綁架案，以確保安全。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The police swiftly developed a plan to respond to the child's kidnap case, to ensure safety.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 警察は子供の誘拐事件に迅速に対応する計画を立て、安全を確保した。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 경찰은 아이의 유괴 사건에 대응하기 위해 신속하게 계획을 세워 안전을 확보했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Cảnh sát đã nhanh chóng xây dựng một kế hoạch để ứng phó với vụ bắt cóc trẻ em, nhằm bảo đảm an toàn.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ตำรวจได้พัฒนาแผนอย่างรวดเร็วเพื่อตอบสนองต่อคดีลักพาตัวเด็ก เพื่อให้มั่นใจในความปลอดภัย

exhibits.definition: to describe or present something in a false or inaccurate way
exhibits.example: Sales staff must not misrepresent warranty terms when explaining the service package to customers.

translations.th_TH: บิดเบือน; เพื่อปลอมแปลง

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 以虛假或不準確的方式描述或呈現某事
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かを虚偽または不正確に説明・提示する

exhibits.definition: to move goods or people illegally into or out of a place

exhibits.definition: a thief who steals from people's pockets or bags in public places

exhibits.definition: on or related to the outside of something

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Ở khu vực đô thị, một số khu nhà ở không chỉ cung cấp chỗ ở mà còn tổ chức các hoạt động cộng đồng và cung cấp nguồn lực cho cư dân.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในเขตเมือง ที่อยู่อาศัยบางแห่งไม่เพียงแต่ให้ที่พักพิงเท่านั้น แต่ยังมีกิจกรรมชุมชนและทรัพยากรสำหรับผู้อยู่อาศัยด้วย

exhibits.definition: a long passage inside a building with rooms along it
exhibits.example: The corridor of the school showcases students' works, displaying their talents and creativity for everyone to appreciate.

translations.th_TH: โถงทางเดิน; ทางเดิน

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 走廊，通道
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 廊下、通路
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 복도, 회랑
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: hành lang

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 學校的走廊上擺放著學生的作品，展示了他們的才華與創意，讓每個人都能欣賞到。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The corridor of the school showcases students' works, displaying their talents and creativity for everyone to appreciate.

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Hành lang của trường trưng bày các tác phẩm của học sinh, thể hiện tài năng và sự sáng tạo của các em để mọi người cùng thưởng thức.

exhibits.definition: a very large and impressive house
exhibits.example: This magnificent mansion features a renowned architectural design and is one of the most sought-after residences in the city.

translations.th_TH: อสังหาริมทรัพย์; คฤหาสน์

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 非常大且雄偉的住宅
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 非常に大きくて立派な邸宅
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 매우 크고 인상적인 저택
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: một ngôi nhà rất lớn và ấn tượng
definitionTranslations.th_TH: บ้านขนาดใหญ่และหรูหราโอ่อ่ามาก

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 這座壯觀的大廈擁有著名的建築設計，是城市中最受追捧的居住地之一。
exampleTranslations.en_US: This magnificent mansion features a renowned architectural design and is one of the most sought-after residences in the city.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: この壮麗な邸宅は、名高い建築デザインを備えており、市内で最も人気の高い住居の一つです。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 웅장한 저택은 명성 높은 건축 디자인을 갖추고 있으며, 도시에서 가장 선호되는 주거지 중 하나입니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Ngôi biệt thự tráng lệ này sở hữu một thiết kế kiến trúc danh tiếng và là một trong những nơi ở được săn đón nhất trong thành phố.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: คฤหาสน์อันโอ่อ่าแห่งนี้มีการออกแบบสถาปัตยกรรมที่มีชื่อเสียง และเป็นหนึ่งในที่อยู่อาศัยที่เป็นที่ต้องการมากที่สุดในเมือง

exhibits.definition: a tall vertical support for a building or structure

translations.th_TH: เสาหลัก

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 柱子，支柱

definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 기둥, 지주
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: cột, trụ

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 這座古老建築的每一根支柱都象徵著這個社區的堅韌和團結。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Each pillar in this ancient structure represents the strength and unity of the community.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: この古代の建造物の柱は一本一本が、共同体の力と結束を表しています。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 고대 건축물의 기둥 하나하나는 공동체의 힘과 단결을 상징합니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Mỗi cột trụ trong công trình cổ xưa này tượng trưng cho sức mạnh và sự đoàn kết của cộng đồng.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เสาแต่ละต้นในโครงสร้างโบราณนี้เป็นตัวแทนของความเข้มแข็งและความเป็นหนึ่งเดียวของชุมชน

exhibits.definition: a set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, or a single step in a flight of stairs
exhibits.example: Because the elevator was broken, we had to walk up every single stair to reach the fifth floor.

translations.th_TH: บันได

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 連接建築物樓層的一組台階，或樓梯中的一級
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 建物の階をつなぐ段のまとまり、または階段の一段

definitionTranslations.vi_VN: dãy bậc dẫn từ tầng này sang tầng khác, hoặc một bậc trong cầu thang
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ชุดขั้นบันไดที่นำจากชั้นหนึ่งไปอีกชั้นหนึ่ง หรือขั้นเดียวในบันได

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 因為電梯壞了，我們不得不踏過每一個台階才能到達五樓。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Because the elevator was broken, we had to walk up every single stair to reach the fifth floor.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: エレベーターが故障していたため、5階に到達するには階段の段を一つずつ登らなければなりませんでした。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 엘리베이터가 고장 났기 때문에 우리는 5층에 도달하기 위해 모든 계단을 하나씩 걸어 올라가야 했습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Vì thang máy bị hỏng, chúng tôi phải bước lên từng bậc thang để lên đến tầng năm.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เนื่องจากลิฟต์เสีย พวกเราจึงต้องเดินขึ้นบันไดทีละขั้นเพื่อไปยังชั้นห้า

exhibits.definition: to fail to notice or consider something
exhibits.example: In this project, we cannot afford to overlook any details, as every part is crucial to success.

translations.th_TH: มองข้าม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 未注意到或考慮某事
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かに気づかない、または考慮しない

exampleTranslations.en_US: In this project, we cannot afford to overlook any details, as every part is crucial to success.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: このプロジェクトでは、細部を見落とす余裕はありません。すべての部分が成功に欠かせないからです。

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong dự án này, chúng ta không thể bỏ qua bất kỳ chi tiết nào, vì mọi phần đều quan trọng đối với thành công.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในโครงการนี้ เราไม่สามารถละเว้นรายละเอียดใด ๆ ได้ เนื่องจากทุกส่วนมีความสำคัญต่อความสำเร็จ

exhibits.definition: to strongly criticize something as wrong or unacceptable
exhibits.example: Human rights groups publicly condemn the violent treatment of peaceful protesters.

translations.ja_JP: 批判すること。非難する
translations.th_TH: วิพากษ์วิจารณ์; เพื่อประณาม

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かを誤り、または容認できないとして強く批判する

definitionTranslations.vi_VN: chỉ trích mạnh mẽ điều gì đó là sai trái hoặc không thể chấp nhận được
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ประณามหรือวิพากษ์วิจารณ์บางสิ่งอย่างรุนแรงว่าผิดหรือไม่สามารถยอมรับได้

exampleTranslations.en_US: Human rights groups publicly condemn the violent treatment of peaceful protesters.

exampleTranslations.th_TH: กลุ่มสิทธิมนุษยชนประณามการประพฤติรุนแรงต่อผู้ประท้วงโดยสงบอย่างเปิดเผย

exhibits.definition: a room with toilets and sinks for public use

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 公共用の便器と洗面台がある部屋

exhibits.definition: a building where students live, usually at a school or college

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 通常は学校や大学で学生が住む建物

exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 学生はキャンパスの救済の中で生活しており、友達を作ったり活動に参加したりする機会を与えています。

exhibits.definition: a moving staircase that carries people between floors

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 手扶梯、電扶梯
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: エスカレーター
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 에스컬레이터
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: thang cuốn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: บันไดเลื่อน

exampleTranslations.en_US: In the busy subway station, the escalator is the most popular mode of transport, as it quickly takes passengers to different levels.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: にぎやかな地下鉄の駅では、エスカレーターが最も人気のある交通手段で、乗客を素早く各階へ運んでくれる。

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Ở ga tàu điện ngầm đông đúc, thang cuốn là phương tiện di chuyển được ưa chuộng nhất vì nó nhanh chóng đưa hành khách lên các tầng khác nhau.

exhibits.definition: a product or raw material that can be bought and sold

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 可買賣的產品或原材料
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 売買できる製品または原材料
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 사고팔 수 있는 제품이나 원자재
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: sản phẩm hoặc nguyên liệu thô có thể mua bán
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สินค้า หรือวัตถุดิบที่ซื้อขายได้

exampleTranslations.en_US: In global trade, the circulation of commodity plays an important role in the economic development of nations, affecting market supply and demand.

exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 세계 무역에서 상품의 유통은 각국의 경제 발전에 중요한 역할을 하며, 시장의 수요와 공급에 영향을 미칩니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong thương mại toàn cầu, sự lưu thông hàng hóa đóng vai trò quan trọng trong sự phát triển kinh tế của các quốc gia, tác động đến cung và cầu của thị trường.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในการค้าทั่วโลก การหมุนเวียนของสินค้าโภคภัณฑ์มีบทบาทสำคัญต่อการพัฒนาเศรษฐกิจของประเทศต่าง ๆ และส่งผลต่ออุปสงค์และอุปทานของตลาด

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 経済や社会が国際的につながっていく過程
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 경제와 사회가 국제적으로 연결되는 과정
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: quá trình các nền kinh tế và xã hội trở nên kết nối trên phạm vi quốc tế
definitionTranslations.th_TH: กระบวนการที่เศรษฐกิจและสังคมเชื่อมโยงกันในระดับนานาชาติ

exampleTranslations.en_US: Rapid globalization has pushed even small firms to compete in international markets.

definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 요약하다, 단축하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: cô đọng, rút ngắn thông tin hoặc bài viết nhưng giữ lại các ý chính
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ย่อหรือทำให้ข้อมูล งานเขียน หรือการพูดสั้นลงแต่ยังคงเก็บใจความสำคัญไว้

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在編輯文本或影片時，有時需要濃縮信息，以便讓觀眾更容易理解。
exampleTranslations.en_US: When editing texts or videos, it is sometimes necessary to condense the information so that the audience can understand it more easily.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 文章や動画を編集するとき、視聴者がより理解しやすいように、情報を凝縮する必要があることがあります。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 글이나 영상을 편집할 때, 때로는 청중이 더 쉽게 이해할 수 있도록 정보를 압축할 필요가 있습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khi biên tập văn bản hoặc video, đôi khi cần cô đọng thông tin để khán giả có thể hiểu dễ dàng hơn.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เมื่อแก้ไขข้อความหรือวิดีโอ บางครั้งจำเป็นต้องย่อข้อมูลให้กระชับ เพื่อให้ผู้ชมเข้าใจได้ง่ายขึ้น

exhibits.definition: to make a word, phrase, or text shorter
exhibits.example: Of course, when you write academic papers, you often need to abbreviate certain commonly used terms to save space.

translations.th_TH: ย่อคำ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 縮短單字、片語或文章
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 単語、フレーズ、または文章を短縮する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 단어, 구 또는 본문을 더 짧게 만들다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: làm cho một từ, cụm từ hoặc văn bản ngắn hơn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ทำให้คำ วลี หรือข้อความสั้นลง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 當然，當你撰寫學術文章時，經常會需要縮寫某些常用詞語以節省空間。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Of course, when you write academic papers, you often need to abbreviate certain commonly used terms to save space.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: もちろん、学術論文を書くときは、紙幅を節約するために、よく使われる特定の用語を略記する必要がよくあります。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 물론 학술 논문을 쓸 때는 지면을 절약하기 위해 자주 쓰이는 특정 용어를 약어로 써야 하는 경우가 많습니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Tất nhiên, khi viết các bài báo học thuật, bạn thường cần viết tắt một số thuật ngữ thường dùng để tiết kiệm chỗ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: แน่นอนว่าเมื่อคุณเขียนบทความวิชาการ คุณมักจำเป็นต้องย่อคำศัพท์ที่ใช้กันบ่อยบางคำเพื่อประหยัดพื้นที่

exhibits.definition: a flat paper cover used to hold a letter or document
exhibits.example: Before mailing the letter, don't forget to put it in an envelope to ensure it is delivered safely.

translations.th_TH: ซองจดหมาย

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 用來裝信件或文件的扁平紙套
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 手紙や書類を入れる平たい紙の袋
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 편지나 문서를 담는 납작한 종이 봉투
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: bao giấy phẳng dùng để đựng thư hoặc tài liệu
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ซองกระดาษแบนสำหรับใส่จดหมายหรือเอกสาร

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在寄信之前，不要忘記把信放進信封裡，這樣才能確保它安全送達。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Before mailing the letter, don't forget to put it in an envelope to ensure it is delivered safely.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 手紙を郵送する前に、確実に安全に届けられるよう、封筒に入れることを忘れないでください。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 편지를 우편으로 보내기 전에, 안전하게 전달되도록 봉투에 넣는 것을 잊지 마세요.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trước khi gửi thư, đừng quên cho nó vào phong bì để đảm bảo nó được chuyển phát an toàn.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ก่อนส่งจดหมาย อย่าลืมใส่ลงในซองจดหมายเพื่อให้ส่งถึงอย่างปลอดภัย

exhibits.definition: to make an exact copy of something
exhibits.example: The assistant will duplicate the signed agreement for each department's records.

translations.th_TH: ทำสำเนา

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 製作某物的精確副本
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かの正確なコピーを作る
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 무언가의 정확한 사본을 만들다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: tạo một bản sao chính xác của thứ gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ทำสำเนาที่ตรงกันทุกประการของบางสิ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 助理會為每個部門的紀錄複製這份已簽署的協議。
exampleTranslations.en_US: The assistant will duplicate the signed agreement for each department's records.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: アシスタントは、署名済みの契約書を各部署の記録用に複製します。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 비서는 서명된 계약서를 각 부서의 기록용으로 복제할 것입니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trợ lý sẽ sao chép thỏa thuận đã ký cho hồ sơ của từng bộ phận.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ผู้ช่วยจะทำสำเนาข้อตกลงที่ลงนามแล้วสำหรับบันทึกของแต่ละแผนก

exhibits.definition: a small thin book that gives information about something
exhibits.example: We distributed a beautifully designed booklet at the conference, which included all the important information and schedule for the event.

translations.th_TH: สมุดเล่มเล็ก

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 提供某事資訊的薄小冊子
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かについて情報を示す薄い小冊子
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 어떤 것에 대한 정보를 제공하는 작고 얇은 책자
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: cuốn sách nhỏ mỏng cung cấp thông tin về điều gì đó
definitionTranslations.th_TH: หนังสือเล่มเล็กบางที่ให้ข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับบางสิ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 我們在會議上分發了一個精美的小冊子，裡面包含了此次活動的所有重要資訊和日程安排。
exampleTranslations.en_US: We distributed a beautifully designed booklet at the conference, which included all the important information and schedule for the event.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 私たちは会議で、美しくデザインされた小冊子を配布し、それにはイベントのすべての重要な情報と日程が載っていた。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 우리는 회의에서 아름답게 디자인된 소책자를 배포했는데, 거기에는 행사에 대한 모든 중요한 정보와 일정이 들어 있었다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Chúng tôi đã phát một cuốn sách nhỏ được thiết kế đẹp mắt tại hội nghị, trong đó có tất cả thông tin quan trọng và lịch trình của sự kiện.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เราแจกจ่ายหนังสือเล่มเล็กที่ออกแบบอย่างสวยงามในงานประชุม ซึ่งมีข้อมูลสำคัญทั้งหมดและตารางงานของกิจกรรม

exhibits.definition: to leave something out or not include it
exhibits.example: When writing reports, it is sometimes possible to inadvertently omit important details, which can affect overall clarity.

translations.th_TH: ที่จะยกเว้น; ที่จะข้าม

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 省略某物或不包含它
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かを省く、含めない
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 무언가를 빼거나 포함하지 않다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: bỏ sót hoặc không bao gồm điều gì
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ละเว้นหรือไม่รวมบางสิ่ง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 當撰寫報告時，有時可能會不小心省略重要的細節，這可能會影響整體的清晰度。
exampleTranslations.en_US: When writing reports, it is sometimes possible to inadvertently omit important details, which can affect overall clarity.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 報告書を書く際には、重要な詳細をうっかり省略してしまうことがあり、それが全体の明確さに影響を与えることがある。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 보고서를 작성할 때 중요한 세부 사항을 무심코 생략할 수 있으며, 이는 전체적인 명확성에 영향을 줄 수 있다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khi viết báo cáo, đôi khi có thể vô tình lược bỏ những chi tiết quan trọng, điều này có thể ảnh hưởng đến độ rõ ràng tổng thể.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เมื่อเขียนรายงาน บางครั้งอาจเผลอละเว้นรายละเอียดสำคัญ ซึ่งอาจส่งผลต่อความชัดเจนโดยรวม

exhibits.definition: to surround an area with a wall, fence, or barrier
exhibits.example: When constructing the new park, workers will enclose the area to ensure safety.

translations.th_TH: ล้อมรอบ; เพื่อรั้วใน

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 用牆、圍欄或障礙物圍住某區域
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 壁、柵、または障壁で区域を囲む
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 벽, 울타리, 장벽으로 구역을 둘러싸다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: bao quanh một khu vực bằng tường, hàng rào hoặc rào chắn
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ล้อมพื้นที่ด้วยกำแพง รั้ว หรือสิ่งกีดขวาง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 在建設新公園時，工作人員會圍住該區域以確保安全。
exampleTranslations.en_US: When constructing the new park, workers will enclose the area to ensure safety.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 新しい公園を建設するとき、作業員たちは安全を確保するためにその区域を囲います。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 새 공원을 건설할 때 작업자들은 안전을 확보하기 위해 그 구역을 둘러쌉니다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khi xây dựng công viên mới, công nhân sẽ bao quanh khu vực để bảo đảm an toàn.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เมื่อก่อสร้างสวนสาธารณะแห่งใหม่ คนงานจะล้อมพื้นที่ไว้เพื่อให้แน่ใจว่าเกิดความปลอดภัย

exhibits.definition: not producing sound or set so that sound is off
exhibits.example: When you don't want to disturb others, you can set your phone to mute mode to avoid bringing noise into public spaces.

translations.th_TH: ปิดเสียง

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 不發出聲音或設定為關閉聲音的
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 音を出さない、または音がオフに設定された
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 소리가 나지 않거나 소리가 꺼지도록 설정된
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: không phát ra âm thanh hoặc được đặt tắt tiếng
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ไม่เกิดเสียงหรือตั้งค่าให้ปิดเสียง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 當你不想打擾他人時，可以將電話設置為靜音模式，以避免將噪音帶入公眾場合。
exampleTranslations.en_US: When you don't want to disturb others, you can set your phone to mute mode to avoid bringing noise into public spaces.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 他人の迷惑になりたくないときは、公共の場に騒音を持ち込まないように、携帯電話をマナーモードに設定できます。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 다른 사람들을 방해하고 싶지 않을 때는 공공장소에 소음을 가져오지 않도록 휴대전화를 무음 모드로 설정할 수 있다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khi bạn không muốn làm phiền người khác, bạn có thể đặt điện thoại ở chế độ im lặng để tránh gây ồn ào ở nơi công cộng.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เมื่อคุณไม่ต้องการรบกวนผู้อื่น คุณสามารถตั้งโทรศัพท์เป็นโหมดปิดเสียงเพื่อหลีกเลี่ยงการนำเสียงรบกวนเข้าไปในที่สาธารณะ

exhibits.definition: a seminar or presentation held live over the internet
exhibits.example: More than three hundred marketers joined the webinar from home offices worldwide.

translations.zh_TW: 線上研討會；網路研討會
translations.ja_JP: オンラインセミナー。ウェブセミナー
translations.vi_VN: hội thảo trực tuyến; hội thảo trên web
translations.th_TH: สัมมนาออนไลน์ สัมมนาผ่านเว็บ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 透過網路現場舉行的研討會或簡報
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: インターネット上で生配信されるセミナーや発表
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 인터넷을 통해 실시간으로 진행되는 세미나 또는 발표
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: hội thảo hoặc buổi thuyết trình trực tiếp qua mạng
definitionTranslations.th_TH: สัมมนาหรือการนำเสนอสดผ่านอินเทอร์เน็ต

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 全球有超過三百名行銷人員在自家辦公室參加這場線上研討會。
exampleTranslations.en_US: More than three hundred marketers joined the webinar from home offices worldwide.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 世界各地の自宅オフィスから、300人を超えるマーケティング担当者がオンラインセミナーに参加しました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 전 세계의 자택 사무실에서 300명이 넘는 마케팅 담당자가 온라인 세미나에 참여했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Hơn ba trăm chuyên viên tiếp thị đã tham gia hội thảo trực tuyến từ văn phòng tại nhà trên khắp thế giới.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: นักการตลาดกว่าสามร้อยคนเข้าร่วมสัมมนาออนไลน์จากสำนักงานที่บ้านทั่วโลก

exhibits.definition: the ability or quality of being connected to a network
exhibits.example: Guests complained about poor Wi-Fi connectivity on the upper floors.

translations.th_TH: การเข้าถึงเครือข่าย การเชื่อมต่อ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 連接至網路的能力或品質
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: ネットワークに接続できる能力または性質
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 네트워크에 연결될 수 있는 능력이나 정도
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: khả năng hoặc mức độ kết nối với một mạng
definitionTranslations.th_TH: ความสามารถหรือคุณภาพในการเชื่อมต่อกับเครือข่าย

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 房客抱怨較高樓層的 Wi-Fi 連線品質不佳。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Guests complained about poor Wi-Fi connectivity on the upper floors.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 宿泊客は、上層階のWi-Fi接続状況が悪いと苦情を申し立てました。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 투숙객들은 위층의 좋지 않은 Wi-Fi 연결 상태에 불만을 제기했다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khách lưu trú phàn nàn về khả năng kết nối Wi-Fi kém ở các tầng trên.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: แขกร้องเรียนว่าการเชื่อมต่อ Wi-Fi บนชั้นบน ๆ ไม่ดี

exhibits.definition: unwanted involvement or disturbance that prevents something from working properly
exhibits.example: Radio interference may affect the clarity and quality of the signals we receive.

translations.th_TH: การรบกวน; การหยุดชะงัก

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 阻礙事物正常運作的干擾或干涉
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 何かが正常に機能するのを妨げる不要な関与や妨害
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 무언가가 제대로 작동하지 못하도록 방해하는 원치 않는 개입이나 혼선
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: sự can thiệp hoặc quấy rầy không mong muốn ngăn cản hoạt động bình thường
definitionTranslations.th_TH: การแทรกแซงหรือการรบกวนที่ไม่พึงประสงค์ซึ่งขัดขวางไม่ให้บางสิ่งทำงานได้อย่างถูกต้อง

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 電波的干擾可能會影響我們接收信號的清晰度和質量。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Radio interference may affect the clarity and quality of the signals we receive.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: ラジオは、私たちが受信する信号の明瞭さや品質に影響を与える場合があります。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 무선 간섭은 우리가 수신하는 신호의 선명도와 품질에 영향을 줄 수 있다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nhiễu vô tuyến có thể ảnh hưởng đến độ rõ và chất lượng của các tín hiệu chúng ta nhận được.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: วิทยุรบกวนอาจส่งผลต่อความชัดเจนและคุณภาพของสัญญาณที่เราได้รับ

exhibits.definition: to separate a device, service, or connection from a network or supply
exhibits.example: Select this button to disconnect the computer from the wireless network by breaking its connection.

translations.th_TH: ตัดการเชื่อมต่อ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 將設備、服務或連接與網路或供應源分離、斷開
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 装置、サービス、または接続をネットワークや供給源から切り離す
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 장치, 서비스 또는 연결을 네트워크나 공급원으로부터 분리하다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: tách một thiết bị, dịch vụ hoặc kết nối khỏi mạng hoặc nguồn cung cấp
definitionTranslations.th_TH: แยกอุปกรณ์ บริการ หรือการเชื่อมต่อออกจากเครือข่ายหรือแหล่งจ่าย

exampleTranslations.zh_TW: 點擊此按鈕以斷開電腦與無線網路的連線。
exampleTranslations.en_US: Select this button to disconnect the computer from the wireless network by breaking its connection.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: このボタンをクリックして、コンピュータを無線ネットワークから切断します。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 버튼을 클릭하여 컴퓨터를 무선 네트워크에서 분리합니다.

exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 고대의 두루마리에는 이 문명의 역사가 담겨 있어 심층 연구를 하는 학자들을 끌어들인다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Những cuộn giấy cổ chứa đựng lịch sử của nền văn minh này, thu hút các học giả đến nghiên cứu chuyên sâu.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: คัมภีร์โบราณเหล่านี้บันทึกประวัติของอารยธรรมนี้ และดึงดูดนักวิชาการให้มาศึกษาอย่างลึกซึ้ง

exhibits.definition: to collect information from different places and arrange it in one work or list
exhibits.example: In order to write an authoritative reference book, the author must compile a vast amount of sources and information.

translations.th_TH: รวบรวม; เพื่อประกอบ

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 彙編、收集並整理（資料等）
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: （情報を様々な場所から集めて）編集する、まとめる
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 엮다, 편집하다, 수집하다

definitionTranslations.th_TH: รวบรวมข้อมูลจากสถานที่ต่างๆ และจัดระเบียบให้อยู่ในรูปแบบงานหรือรายการเดียวกัน

exampleTranslations.ja_JP: 権威ある参考書を書くためには、著者は膨大な数の資料や情報を集めてまとめなければならない。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 권위 있는 참고서를 쓰려면 저자는 방대한 양의 자료와 정보를 모아 정리해야 한다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Để viết một cuốn sách tham khảo có tính thẩm quyền, tác giả phải tập hợp một lượng lớn nguồn tư liệu và thông tin.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: เพื่อเขียนหนังสืออ้างอิงที่น่าเชื่อถือ ผู้เขียนต้องรวบรวมแหล่งข้อมูลและข้อมูลจำนวนมหาศาล

exhibits.definition: the outer limit of knowledge, development, or activity

translations.th_TH: ชายแดน

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 知識、發展或活動的外在界限
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 知識、開発、または活動の限界
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 지식, 발달, 활동의 외부 한계

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Nhiều cuộc khám phá khoa học diễn ra ở tiền tuyến của tri thức, không ngừng mở rộng hiểu biết của nhân loại về vũ trụ.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: การสำรวจทางวิทยาศาสตร์หลายอย่างเกิดขึ้นที่แนวหน้าของความรู้ และผลักดันความเข้าใจของมนุษยชาติเกี่ยวกับจักรวาลอย่างต่อเนื่อง

exhibits.definition: an early model used to test or develop a product or idea

translations.th_TH: ต้นแบบ

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 製品やアイデアを試験・開発するための初期モデル
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 제품이나 아이디어를 시험하거나 개발하는 데 쓰는 초기 모델

exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Trong giai đoạn phát triển sản phẩm, nhà thiết kế đã tạo ra một nguyên mẫu để kiểm tra chức năng của sản phẩm.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ในช่วงพัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ นักออกแบบได้สร้างต้นแบบขึ้นมาเพื่อทดสอบการทำงานของผลิตภัณฑ์

exhibits.definition: an important discovery or development that solves a problem

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 問題を解決する重要な発見や進展

exhibits.definition: to find and get information from a system or source

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 從系統或來源尋找並取得資訊
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: システムや情報源から情報を見つけて取得する
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 시스템이나 출처에서 정보를 찾아 가져오다
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: tìm và lấy thông tin từ hệ thống hoặc nguồn

definitionTranslations.ja_JP: エネルギー、興味、効果を回復させる
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 에너지, 관심, 효과를 새롭게 하다

exampleTranslations.en_US: This forest boasts lush vegetation and a rich wildlife ecosystem, making it an ideal location for outdoor adventures.
exampleTranslations.ja_JP: この森は豊かな植生と豊富な野生生物の生態系を誇っており、アウトドアの冒険には理想的な場所です。
exampleTranslations.ko_KR: 이 숲은 울창한 식생과 풍부한 야생 생태계를 자랑하며, 야외 모험을 즐기기에 이상적인 장소이다.
exampleTranslations.vi_VN: Khu rừng này tự hào có thảm thực vật tươi tốt và hệ sinh thái động vật hoang dã phong phú, khiến nơi đây trở thành địa điểm lý tưởng cho những chuyến phiêu lưu ngoài trời.
exampleTranslations.th_TH: ป่าแห่งนี้มีพืชพรรณอุดมสมบูรณ์และระบบนิเวศสัตว์ป่าที่อุดมไปด้วยความหลากหลาย ทำให้เป็นสถานที่ที่เหมาะอย่างยิ่งสำหรับการผจญภัยกลางแจ้ง

exhibits.definition: lost or without a home

definitionTranslations.zh_TW: 迷路或無家可歸的
definitionTranslations.ja_JP: 迷子の、または住む家のない
definitionTranslations.ko_KR: 길을 잃었거나 집이 없는
definitionTranslations.vi_VN: bị lạc hoặc không có nhà
definitionTranslations.th_TH: หลงทางหรือไม่มีบ้าน
